title: Establish Windows native picker test environment prerequisites
outcome: Claude7199 notes non-showing FileOpenDialog COM creation test may depend on shell availability on service/session-0/container Windows runners. Verify the supported runner behavior before adding ignore/env gating; do not disable a passing regression based solely on an assumed interactive-desktop requirement. Document prerequisites and explicit environment diagnostics. Visible focus and mixed-monitor smoke remains separate in tm-i1q7.
